name: Wild Hunter - Prototype 01
goals: Patrol the woods and carry out any specific search orders.
gmNotes:
Describe the Fey and his bike from the perspective of an Iron Age human who has never seen a hoverbike. From afar, it resembles a frightening dark horse with glowing red eyes; from close up, it resembles a metallic hovering sledge shaped like a horse's back and head.

The Fey wears black and brown with a helmet and opaque visor, and has blackish skin. The black-and-brown attire is a deliberate visual exception retained to match this prototype's image. Like all Fey, he has four upward-curving, tentacular legs and two arms. He does NOT wear boots.

From afar, undergrowth may hide the fact that the hoverbike has no legs. It makes a metallic galloping sound. Its mechanical nature becomes clear only at close range.
description: Dressed in black and brown with a helmet and opaque visor, he rides a mount that might be a horse—or something completely different.
